description: Implementation of TTSManager class handling Text-to-Speech configurations, speech control, and callback notifications.

classes.name: TTSManager
classes.description: Manages Text-to-Speech configurations, speech operations, and callback notifications.

methods.description: Reads TTS configuration from a file and updates default configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new TTSManager instance with thread safety.

methods.name: TTSManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing TTSManager with callback, loading configuration, and setting up speaker.

methods.name: ~TTSManager
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up speaker instance.

methods.description: Enables or disables TTS functionality and updates pipeline accordingly.

methods.description: Lists available voices for a given language or the current configuration.

methods.description: Updates default TTS configuration.

methods.description: Callback invoked when speech completes.

methods.name: resumed
methods.description: Callback invoked when speech resumes.
